preconditions.message: Only a normal region can enter emergency mode
Only an emergency region can be recovered
Only an operational substation can be isolated
Only an isolated substation can be energized
Only a detected outage can be assessed
Outage is already escalated
Only an escalated outage can be contained
Only a contained outage can be restored
Only an available crew can be deployed
Only a deployed crew can be released
Only a queued work order can be assigned
Only an assigned work order can be started
Only an active work order can be completed
Only a draft safety permit can be approved
Only an approved safety permit can be activated
Only an active safety permit can be closed
Only an open customer impact can be notified
Customer impact is already resolved
Only a draft restoration plan can be approved
Only an approved restoration plan can be started
Only an active restoration plan can be completed
Only a pending decision can be approved
Only a pending decision can be rejected
Only a draft update can be published
